text:
The Activity:

Make labels that tell you who things belong to and put them on the things around your house!
  1. Think about who it belongs to, e.g. Mum.
  2. Write their name on your label.
  3. Write ’s after their name, e.g. Mum’s
  4. Write the thing after that, e.g. Mum’s shoes.


Top Tips:

  • Make sure your apostrophe is the same shape as a comma – a little dot with a short, curly tail.
  • Make sure your apostrophe is floating in the air at about the same height as tall letters and capital letters.
  • Make sure the word with the apostrophe in still looks like a word – give the apostrophe some room but not big spaces like finger spaces!
There are several ways apostrophes can be used. In these activities, we are looking at apostrophes that show something belongs to someone.
